data.content_ref: inline:Replace the Boolean status assignment with a finite distributive lattice of epistemic grounding levels. The transition operator is monotone over the lattice product; the grounded extension is the least fixed point projected to Boolean acceptance. Determinism and polynomial cost hold because the lattice is finite and the operator is polynomial-time computable. Reinstatement is a derived property of the lattice order: a defended argument's ground level is at least the meet of its defenders' levels. Criticizable: the choice of lattice levels is external and may smuggle in preference; root validity must be verified for the projection.
